publication_scope: Evidence for the custom recovery menu and the live boot screen on OPWWE231 A.192: flight recorder text read back from misc, a simulation regression log, strings of the stock boot animation player, the power button policy and player log excerpts. No firmware, ramdisk or partition contents are included here; the modified images are published separately under releases/.
private_source_paths: Relative to backups/oneplus-watch-2/. Originals stay excluded by /backups/ in .gitignore.

sources.tools/recovery-menu/notes/flightlog_v9b_: Flight recorder dump read with read_flightlog.sh after the V9B run; the published file keeps only the three sessions of the v9 menu line (v9, v9, V9B) and adds a comment header.
sources.tools/recovery-menu/notes/sim_regression: Output of tools/opwwe231/recovery-menu/src/test_sim9.sh run as root on the watch; copied with a one-line header.
sources.scratchpad rea_strings.json: REA execute-rizin-command (izz) on /system/lib/libbootanimation.so pulled from the watch; filtered in Python to BootAnimation method names and path/property strings. REA evidence_id ev_087f97f036dfce33ee9bd83f36ce5c6c767d54be7a8614f064b8a95d47653459.

other_evidence.power-button-policy-excerpt.txt: Selected lines from dumpsys window policy and settings list, captured in-session over adb.
other_evidence.live-boot-console-excerpts.txt: Selected logcat, dmesg and screencap observations captured in-session; the red/green frame test centre pixels were decoded from screencap -p output.
other_evidence.shortcutkeyctrl-power-long-press-excerpt: Decompiled Java of two methods of com.android.server.policy.ShortcutKeyCtrl (services.jar classes2.dex), produced by REA inspect-android-method (JADX headless 0.7.1); logcat lines captured in-session.
